title: Capturing the risk of persisting depressive symptoms: A dynamic network investigation of patients' daily symptom experiences
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether it was preregistered. However, the supplementary materials mention the use of permutation testing code developed by Wolfgang Viechtbauer, which suggests methodological transparency. The code is declared available in the supplementary materials. Data are declared available in the online version with DOI: 10.1016/j.psychres.2018.12.054.
